id: 34_National Safety Day Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition @hsestudyguide
title: 别国的安全日：十道问答（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/34_National Safety Day Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition @hsestudyguide.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/34_National Safety Day Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition @hsestudyguide（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 安全日为了推广防事故
points.K4: 劳工部门倡议成立理事会
points.K6: 理事会为危险行业而设
points.K7: 年度活动为提高危害认识
points.K11: 总体目标：强化安全文化
points.S3: 记录数据别长时间低头

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，背景是地球图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium in front of a globe icon and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天看看别国怎么办安全日。
overlay: 别国的安全日：十道问答

shots.scene: 阿杰在走廊看见安全活动海报，打哈欠
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns in front of a blank safety campaign poster in a laboratory corridor.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：安全活动就是走个形式。

shots.scene: 小研拿出空白题卡，笑着递给他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a blank quiz card with a smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：先答答别国安全日的题。

shots.scene: 十张题卡排成两行，下面一个及格线
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank quiz cards in two rows with a pass line drawn below eight of them. No people.
shots.narration: 十道单选，每题一分，八题过关。

shots.scene: 实验楼大厅里摆着抢答台
shots.prompt_en: A small quiz stage with buzzers set up in a laboratory building lobby. No people.
shots.narration: 这种竞赛，我们学院也能办。

shots.section_title: 安全日为了推广防事故
shots.scene: 盾牌挡住事故图标，四周是工厂、学校、办公楼
shots.prompt_en: A shield blocks an accident icon, surrounded by small icons of a factory, a school and an office. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：安全日的主要目标？
overlay: 安全日为了推广防事故

shots.section_title: 安全日为了推广防事故
shots.scene: 奖杯、员工表彰、绿叶图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A trophy, an award ribbon and a green leaf icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 推广事故预防，让各行各业重视安全。

shots.scene: 一本旧历史书翻开，日历上圈出一个春天的日子
shots.prompt_en: An old blank history book opens beside a calendar with one spring date circled. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：首个安全日在哪年？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着日历
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the circled calendar date.
shots.narration: 那一天也是安全理事会正式成立日。

shots.section_title: 劳工部门倡议成立理事会
shots.scene: 四栋部门大楼图标，戴安全帽的那栋亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four government building icons; the one with a hard hat symbol lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：谁倡议成立安全理事会？
overlay: 劳工部门倡议成立理事会

shots.section_title: 劳工部门倡议成立理事会
shots.scene: 工厂越来越多，事故图标随之增加
shots.prompt_en: More and more factory icons appear, and accident icons increase alongside them. No people.
shots.narration: 工业化太快，事故增多，劳工部门提议。

shots.scene: 领导者图标举着盾牌，旁边三片叶子：环境、社会、治理
shots.prompt_en: A leader icon holding a shield, beside three leaves for environment, society and governance. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：那年的安全日主题？

shots.scene: 领导者走在前面，后面的人跟上
shots.prompt_en: A leader icon walks ahead and several person icons follow. No people.
shots.narration: 聚焦安全领导力，带动整体变好。

shots.section_title: 理事会为危险行业而设
shots.scene: 冒烟的化工厂和矿井图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a smoking chemical plant and a mine entrance with warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：安全理事会为什么成立？
overlay: 理事会为危险行业而设

shots.section_title: 理事会为危险行业而设
shots.scene: 盾牌罩住危险行业图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield covers the chemical plant and mine icons. No people.
shots.narration: 在危险行业和工作场所推动安全。

shots.section_title: 年度活动为提高危害认识
shots.scene: 放大镜照着几个危险源图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier over icons of a flame, a chemical bottle and a gear. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：年度安全活动的主要目标？
overlay: 年度活动为提高危害认识

shots.section_title: 年度活动为提高危害认识
shots.scene: 检查、新规、产品图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An inspection icon, a new rule book and a product box, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 让大家认识危害，从而预防事故。

shots.scene: 日历上成立日和安全日是同一天
shots.prompt_en: Two calendar pages side by side with the same date circled on both, joined by a line. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：理事会成立日是哪天？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 原片答案：和首个安全日同一天。

shots.scene: 日历上连续七天被框起
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with seven consecutive days boxed together. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：年度安全活动办多久？

shots.scene: 一天、三天、十天卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Cards showing one day, three days and ten days, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 从安全日开始，连办一周。

shots.scene: 会议桌旁一圈人形图标，主持席亮起
shots.prompt_en: A conference table surrounded by person icons, the chair seat highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：哪次会议批准设立理事会？

shots.scene: 会议桌上盖下批准印章
shots.prompt_en: An approval stamp lands on a document on the conference table. No people.
shots.narration: 一次全国劳工会议，当时的领导人主持。

shots.section_title: 总体目标：强化安全文化
shots.scene: 盾牌、心形、绿叶三个图标连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A shield, a heart and a green leaf icon joined in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：安全日和安全周的总体目标？
overlay: 总体目标：强化安全文化

shots.section_title: 总体目标：强化安全文化
shots.scene: 庆祝、新规、增长图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A celebration icon, a new rule book and a growth chart, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 强化安全、健康、环境的文化。

shots.scene: 阿杰对答案，八题以上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks his answers; more than eight have green checks.
shots.narration: 阿杰过关了，可他还有疑问。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头：这些跟实验室有什么关系
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking from the quiz card to the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 别国的历史，跟我们实验室有关吗？

shots.scene: 小研指向实验室：文化要落到每天
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points toward the laboratory with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：关键是把安全文化落到实验室。

shots.scene: 实验室门口一块空白承诺板，大家签名
shots.prompt_en: Students sign their names on a blank commitment board at a laboratory entrance.
shots.narration: 签安全承诺，不是签完就算。

shots.scene: 阿杰进门戴护目镜、看记录本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on goggles and checks a blank lab log as he enters.
shots.narration: 每天进门戴防护、看记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰离开前关水关电，在检查表打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns off water and power and ticks a blank checklist before leaving.
shots.narration: 离开前关水关电，逐项打勾。

shots.scene: 老周戴着护目镜在实验台前示范
shots.prompt_en: The older man demonstrates at a bench, wearing safety goggles and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 领导力从导师做起。

shots.scene: 老周停下来提醒一位学生扎好头发
shots.prompt_en: The older man pauses to remind a student to tie back her hair.
shots.narration: 自己先做到，看到问题马上提醒。

shots.scene: 老周在组会上讲一个安全案例
shots.prompt_en: The older man shares a safety case on a blank screen during a group meeting.
shots.narration: 组会常讲安全，大家才会重视。

shots.section_title: 记录数据别长时间低头
shots.scene: 阿杰低头盯着平板记录数据，脖子弯成一大角度
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares down at a tablet on the bench to record data, neck bent sharply.
shots.narration: 一直低头看平板，脖子很受累。
overlay: 记录数据别长时间低头

shots.section_title: 记录数据别长时间低头
shots.scene: 平板放上支架，屏幕抬到接近视线
shots.prompt_en: The tablet is placed on a stand, raised close to eye level.
shots.narration: 用支架把屏幕抬高。

shots.section_title: 记录数据别长时间低头
shots.scene: 阿杰抬头转动脖子休息
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up and gently turns his neck during a short break.
shots.narration: 隔一会儿抬头，活动颈部。

shots.scene: 一排图标：盾牌、放大镜、领导者、承诺板
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a shield, a magnifier, a leader figure and a commitment board. No people.
shots.narration: 防事故、识危害、有领导、守承诺。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研在实验室门口互相检查防护
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student check each other's goggles at the lab door.
shots.narration: 安全文化，就在每天的小事里。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 天天都是安全日！
